title: The Session That Stayed
summary: Observe cookie attributes and session fixation, then prove rotation and logout invalidation.
description: A synthetic account service preserves a caller-chosen session ID. Compare it with a fixed session lifecycle and collect remediation evidence.

services.name: session-review
services.purpose: Synthetic cookie and server-side session lifecycle service

objectives.title: Confirm the fixation condition
objectives.label: Compare the supplied session ID and vulnerable login cookie

objectives.title: Prove the repaired lifecycle
objectives.label: Verify cookie attributes, login rotation, and logout invalidation

learningOutcomes: Explain what Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite control
Recognize session fixation and rotate identifiers on authentication
Invalidate server-side sessions and expire cookies on logout
Use positive and negative requests to validate remediation
